name: Eurobank Ergasias Services and Holdings S.A.
summary: Eurobank Ergasias S.A. is a banking group that provides a range of financial services, including retail and corporate banking, wealth management, and investment services, primarily in Greece and Southeastern Europe; the bank is headquartered in Athens, Greece. It operates through a network of branches and digital channels, offering products such as loans, deposits, credit cards, and investment solutions. Eurobank aims to support economic growth and financial well-being for its customers and stakeholders.
